name: recall_mutable_default_argument
about: A None default becomes a list literal, so every call without tags shares -- and grows -- one list.
diff:
diff --git a/tags.py b/tags.py
--- a/tags.py
+++ b/tags.py
@@ -1,4 +1,3 @@
-def add_tag(tag, tags=None):
-    tags = tags or []
+def add_tag(tag, tags=[]):
     tags.append(tag)
     return tags

base_sources.tags.py:
def add_tag(tag, tags=None):
    tags = tags or []
    tags.append(tag)
    return tags

findings.title: Mutable default argument is shared between calls
